name: cost-and-model-gates
description: Tests that cost_under and model_switches assertions work over real transcripts. Direct-execution prompts should stay under a reasonable cost cap and not trigger model fallback.

evals.prompt: What is the capital of France?
evals.description: A trivial factual question should cost under $0.02

assertions.description: Trivial direct answer should cost under $0.02
Should not trigger model fallback for a trivial question

evals.prompt: Run bun run typecheck and report the result.
evals.description: Running a verification command directly should cost under $0.03

assertions.description: Running a simple command should cost under $0.03
Should not need model fallback for a bash command
Should run the command via bash

evals.prompt: How many eval suites are in the src/evals/ directory?
evals.description: A codebase fact question should be answered directly and cost under $0.02
